description: 公开的主执行与异供应方替代组合计算器。输入数量、预算、时限和候选报价，输出符合输入约束的最低成本不同提供方组合。包含明确的 JavaScript、SQL 实现及有限验收案例；输入假设不是现实权限或供应商接受。

value.postgresBody: COALESCE((WITH offers AS (SELECT x->>'id' id,x->>'provider' provider,(x->>'unitPriceMinor')::numeric price,(x->>'leadMinutes')::numeric eta,(x->>'capacity')::numeric capacity FROM jsonb_array_elements(input->'offers') x),pairs AS (SELECT CASE WHEN a.price<b.price OR (a.price=b.price AND a.id<b.id) THEN a.id ELSE b.id END primary_id,CASE WHEN a.price<b.price OR (a.price=b.price AND a.id<b.id) THEN b.id ELSE a.id END alternate_id,(a.price+b.price)*(input->>'quantity')::numeric total,GREATEST(a.eta,b.eta) eta FROM offers a JOIN offers b ON a.id<b.id AND a.provider<>b.provider WHERE a.capacity>=(input->>'quantity')::numeric AND b.capacity>=(input->>'quantity')::numeric AND a.eta<=(input->>'deadlineMinutes')::numeric AND b.eta<=(input->>'deadlineMinutes')::numeric AND (a.price+b.price)*(input->>'quantity')::numeric<=(input->>'maximumTotalMinor')::numeric) SELECT jsonb_build_object('status','FEASIBLE','primary',primary_id,'alternate',alternate_id,'totalMinor',total,'etaMinutes',eta) FROM pairs ORDER BY total,eta,primary_id,alternate_id LIMIT 1),jsonb_build_object('status','UNAVAILABLE'))
